wake_red.assertion: A request submitted during the normal 30-minute sleep was not picked up within the 31-second fixture window.

status_red.assertion: Compiled status ignored the durable attempt and reported awaiting-worker-claim with exit 0.

test_compile_correction.note: Replaced test unwrap_err with err().expect because RunReport does not implement Debug; not behavioral red evidence.

retry_exit_red.assertion: A failed but retryable queued attempt incorrectly returned terminal failure exit 4 instead of deferred exit 3.

verified: Idle background workers poll a read-only, repository-scoped due-job hint every 30 seconds; an unavailable repository identity is retried while normal polling remains available.
The hint uses the same eligibility predicate as transactional selection; unrelated and delayed jobs do not accelerate builder ticks. Active productive stages are not interrupted.
Selection atomically records an unconfirmed attempt. Finished results are fenced by selection time and may not replace a newer selection or an already finished result.

The real targeted background entry point persists missing-runtime deferral before any workflow checkpoint or worktree; a fresh status reader sees execution-readiness-blocked with unknown worker liveness.
Attempt records hold bounded machine reasons, not raw provider output. Existing checkpoints remain authoritative; their JSON includes the latest background attempt separately.
Compiled CLI status reads selected, deferred and failed attempt records without database writes, reports exit 3 while the job remains retryable, and does not fabricate a live worker or head.
limits: The 30-second poll is an idle wake-up interval, not a completion or queue-wait SLA. Active builds, normal-lane fairness, resource/readiness gates and merge-capacity admission still affect pickup.
Status does not infer a currently live worker from historical attempt receipts. Detailed worker/down and global capacity health reporting remains open.
Direct local work-once attempts do not create background scheduling receipts. Their execution checkpoints remain visible through shared status.
Tests use fake clocks, real SQLite, temporary Git and scripted GitHub boundaries. This is not deployed or live native-model acceptance.
Wait/control commands, stale-input re-verification, legacy-hold recovery, Discord sessions/updates, native CLI acceptance, normal updater rollout and required soaks remain open.
